localImplementation.primaryFulfillmentProjection: ordinary pages: current verified fields with linked re-evaluation; strict keyset legacy restrictions retained
localImplementation.linkedSnapshotPublication: four entities: transactional local display, ownership, analytics and graph refresh; incomplete records pending
localImplementation.otherEntityProjection: other entity timestamp acquisition pending; existing dependent projections revalidated
localImplementation.ownershipChangeFence: cleared only after verified parent and all pending projection tasks resolved

ordinaryModifiedPages.liveFullSyncVerificationScope: four-entity full source capture and local transaction commit; unresolved relationships remain pending projection

TIME_QUERY.predicate: L <= t AND t < U AND (cursor is null OR t > afterTime OR (t = afterTime AND id > afterId))
TIME_QUERY.wireMapping: Use each published FOP OpenAPI parameter mapping; these names are capability concepts, not verified endpoint parameters.

window.clockRegression: do not regress checkpoint when U <= W; diagnose source clock
window.advanceCheckpoint: Capture U only after both streams, full details, raw documents and durable projection tasks commit atomically; this is not a display publication watermark
window.emptyWindow: advance only on explicit successful complete response for the verified scope

merge.serialization: one writer per entity and tenant; no overlapping sync/reconciliation writers
merge.identity: tenant+entity+stableId; include company only if source IDs are company-scoped
merge.classification: upsert by identity, not by creation date
merge.sameTimestamp: compare canonical business content; equal timestamp is not equal version
merge.olderTimestamp: quarantine conflict; source-authoritative re-read/reconciliation required before replacement
merge.completeChildren: replace complete entries and relations atomically; never delete based on partial response
merge.missingFields: preserve field presence; omitted is unknown, explicit null clears, unknown is not zero
merge.detailNewerThanWindow: retain actual source time; do not label the row a snapshot at U
merge.dependencies: ordinary pages: rebuild old/new local relationships, permissions, procurement facts and analytics in capture transaction; missing facts remain unknown

compensation.initialization: record source T0 before full stable-ID traversal, then replay from T0-overlap and reconcile
compensation.fullContentCycle: proposed daily, partitionable, tune after load validation; includes closed and historical documents
compensation.hardDelete: platform tombstone if available, otherwise full-ID diff plus authoritative per-ID existence confirmation
compensation.lateCommitAndBackfill: full-content reconciliation repairs changes outside overlap or without timestamp updates
compensation.guarantee: No transaction-history or atomic cross-document snapshot guarantee; convergence requires complete source queries and successful compensation cycles.
